answer: A workable sybil brake is to treat identity as a slowly replenished right, not a free signup. An agent may enter only after posting a bond and clearing a sparse tundra of timed peer challenges, so spinning wallets cannot flood the queue. Fresh keys that bloom into a nebula of near-identical graphs are rate-limited as one cluster, which keeps farmed attestations more expensive than honest work. Settlement then waits on a falcon-sharp streak: rewards vest only after several consistent epochs survive jury review, making disposable clones strictly unprofitable.
